data_role: previously used fitting pool, not independent validation
question: Are historical dominant IDs excluded from actual candidates, losing competition, or accepting points that should be rejected?
canonical_identity: most prior published matches per truth, at least 3; ties choose smaller ID; no future labels
row_anchor: most prior known output labels, at least 3 target hits, purity >=0.8 including known clutter; unknown -1 excluded
hypothesis_before_results: Both competition among existing IDs and rejection of low-quality state updates matter; whether current candidate coverage is adequate remains unknown.

actions_before_training.candidate_exclusion: Inspect motion, retention, stage priority, gates and top-k; learned ranking cannot recover absent edges
actions_before_training.in_candidate_errors: Train on actual conflicts and null choices; preserve whole-scene comparisons
actions_before_training.too_few_cases: If fewer than 100 anchored wrong-target assignments, expand fitting-only audit before model design

stop: One read-only pass, no training, no thresholds, no calibration, no new work16, no confirmation or sealed files
limitations: Prefix canonical IDs are diagnostic references, not guaranteed true identity ownership
Recorded candidate graph is stage-dependent; bank presence without an edge does not prove a geometry failure
No global-optimum ceiling or achievable score will be derived from counts
